privacy.sectionTitle: Your data never leaves your browser.
privacy.sectionDescription: Free CV Creator works 100% locally — no server sees your name, email address, or employment history. No login, no database, no tracking cookies.

noBackend.title: No server, no database
noBackend.description: The app has no backend. Data is stored exclusively in your browser's localStorage.

noAccount.title: Zero accounts, zero email
noAccount.description: We don't ask for any contact details. You start creating your CV right away.

dataGone.title: Data gone after PDF download
dataGone.description: After generating the PDF, localStorage is automatically cleared — or you can save your data as JSON.

free.question: Is the app really completely free?
free.answer: Yes. Free CV Creator is 100% free — there are no premium plans, hidden fees, or paywalls. You can download a PDF on your very first use, with no conditions.

privacy.question: What happens to my personal data?
privacy.answer: Your data never leaves your browser. The app has no server or database. All information is stored exclusively in your browser's localStorage and is deleted after you download the PDF or upon your request.

pdf.question: What is the quality of the generated PDF?
pdf.answer: The PDF is generated by the @react-pdf/renderer library directly in the browser. Text is fully selectable and copyable, and the layout preserves exactly what you see in the preview. The CV is optimized for ATS (Applicant Tracking Systems).

templates.question: How many templates are available and will there be more?
templates.answer: Several professional templates are available at launch. Each template can be customized by choosing an accent color. New templates will be added regularly.

offline.question: Does the app work without internet?
offline.answer: Yes! After the first load, the app can be installed on your device as a PWA (Progressive Web App) and used without internet access. The Service Worker caches all app resources.

import.question: Can I load my previous CV?
import.answer: Yes. You can export your CV data to a JSON file and reload it in the future on any device. The JSON file contains all form data and can be imported via the "Load CV" option in the editor.
